name: Riley Chen
headline: Nursing Student · Volunteer EMT · Runner
tagline: I stay calm when it matters and I show up for people.
bio: I'm a nursing student and a volunteer EMT. I like the moments when a plan has to work under pressure.
I run marathons to stay level, and I mentor first-year students in my program.
